items.headline: Football's officially back next week — and it opens with a Super Bowl rematch
items.body: The wait is nearly over: the NFL season kicks off next Wednesday night (Sept. 9) with a doozy — the Seattle Seahawks host the New England Patriots in a rematch of last February's Super Bowl LX, the one Seattle won behind MVP running back Kenneth Walker III. It's the first Week 1 Super Bowl rematch in a decade, live on NBC and Peacock, with the rest of the league (and that Niners-Rams game in Australia) right on its heels.
items.say: The NFL's finally back next week, and they're opening with a Super Bowl rematch — the Seahawks hosting the Patriots. Seattle won it all last year. You got a team you're riding with this season?

items.headline: Who's the best on the planet? The Ballon d'Or race is heating up — and Rodri's the favorite
items.body: Soccer's big individual prize is coming into focus: the 30 nominees for the 2026 Ballon d'Or get revealed next Tuesday (Sept. 8), ahead of the Oct. 26 ceremony in London. Manchester City midfielder Rodri is the early favorite after anchoring Spain to the World Cup title this summer, with 19-year-old wonderkid Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé right behind him.
items.say: The Ballon d'Or — soccer's award for the single best player in the world — is coming up, and Rodri's the favorite after Spain won the World Cup. That Lamine Yamal kid's right on his heels though. Who'd get your vote?

items.headline: Chasing history — Yordan Álvarez is making a real run at baseball's Triple Crown
items.body: Nobody has won the Major League Triple Crown in 70 years (Mickey Mantle, 1956), and Houston's Yordan Álvarez is giving it a serious shot down the September stretch. He rolled into the month leading the majors in batting average and home runs and sitting near the top in RBIs — though Tampa Bay's Junior Caminero is breathing down his neck in the homer race. Pull it off and he'd be the first since Miguel Cabrera in 2012.
items.say: There's an Astros hitter, Yordan Álvarez, chasing the Triple Crown — leading the league in average, homers and RBIs all at once. Nobody's done it in the big leagues since the '50s. Wild if he actually pulls it off. You keeping an eye on the pennant races?

items.headline: Caitlin Clark's big-stage debut — the Women's Basketball World Cup tips off Friday
items.body: The FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup starts Friday (Sept. 4) in Berlin, and Team USA is chasing a record-tying fifth straight title with a glittering roster: Caitlin Clark, Paige Bueckers and Angel Reese are all making their World Cup debuts. The Americans open against China — though they'll do it without A'ja Wilson and Kelsey Plum, who both pulled out late. It's all on TNT and truTV.
items.say: The Women's Basketball World Cup starts Friday, and it's Caitlin Clark's first time suiting up for the senior national team — her, Paige Bueckers, Angel Reese, the whole new wave. Team USA's going for five titles in a row. You catch any women's hoops?

items.headline: The Temple of Speed awaits — F1 hits Monza with an Italian leading the title race
items.body: A week after the chaos at Zandvoort, Formula 1 rolls into Monza for the Italian Grand Prix on Sunday (Sept. 6) — the fastest, most historic track on the calendar. The extra twist: the championship leader is Kimi Antonelli, the 19-year-old Italian phenom who's been the story of the season, and this is his home race. Expect a sea of tifosi, screaming engines, and plenty of nerves as the title run-in heats up.
items.say: Formula 1's at Monza this weekend — fastest track there is, in front of those wild Italian fans. And the championship leader is a 19-year-old local kid, Antonelli, racing at home. Should be electric. You watch any F1?

items.headline: Ryan Reynolds goes behind enemy lines — 'Mayday' lands on Apple TV Friday
items.body: Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh make a fun odd couple in 'Mayday,' out Friday (Sept. 4) on Apple TV. Reynolds plays a hotshot Navy pilot shot down behind Soviet lines at the height of the Cold War, only to be rescued by Branagh's gruff ex-KGB agent with a soft spot for American culture. It's a big, action-packed buddy comedy — very much in the Reynolds wheelhouse.
items.say: New Ryan Reynolds movie drops Friday on Apple — he's a pilot stuck behind enemy lines in the Cold War, teamed up with an old Russian spy played by Kenneth Branagh. Looks like a fun action-comedy. You an Apple TV person?

items.headline: Guy Ritchie's 'The Gentlemen' is back — Season 2 hits Netflix Thursday
items.body: One of Netflix's slickest crime capers returns: 'The Gentlemen' Season 2 drops all eight episodes Thursday (Sept. 3). Theo James and Kaya Scodelario are back running the aristocratic weed empire — and this time Bobby Glass's increasingly shaky decisions threaten to bring the whole operation down. Netflix already liked it enough to greenlight a Season 3.
items.say: The Gentlemen is back on Netflix this week — that stylish Guy Ritchie crime show about a posh family running a drug empire. Whole new season drops Thursday. Perfect weekend binge. You watch that one?

items.headline: Ellie Goulding is back — her sixth album 'I Know Too Much' drops Friday
items.body: British pop star Ellie Goulding — the voice behind 'Lights' and 'Love Me Like You Do' — returns Friday (Sept. 4) with her sixth album, 'I Know Too Much.' Led by the airy, dance-leaning single 'Black Prada Dress,' it's being billed as her most personal, self-aware record yet — a solid one to headline your New Music Friday.
items.say: New Ellie Goulding album out Friday — the 'Lights' and 'Love Me Like You Do' singer. Been a minute since her last one. You have a go-to for finding new music, or do you just kind of stumble into it?

items.headline: The desert's alive — Burning Man is happening right now in Nevada
items.body: Tens of thousands of people are out in the Nevada desert this week for Burning Man, the wild, week-long art-and-community happening that builds a whole temporary city (Black Rock City, Aug. 30–Sept. 7) and then packs it away without a trace. This year's theme is 'Axis Mundi,' all about interconnectedness — and the big moment, when they torch the giant wooden Man, goes down Saturday night (Sept. 5).
items.say: Burning Man's going on right now out in the Nevada desert — that giant art-and-community thing where they build a temporary city and burn a huge wooden man at the end. Total bucket-list-or-total-nightmare situation. Would you ever go?
